title: Show rack information by changing display mode and selecting the same cell
summary: On the OptiSweep HMI cell grid, changing the display mode to the “if” option and then selecting the same cell again causes the HMI to display rack information for that cell. If a symbol is available on the cell, selecting it provides the symbol’s meaning.
when_to_use: Use when you need rack information for a specific cell on the OptiSweep HMI cell grid, and the HMI does not show the expected rack information until you change the display mode to the “if” option and re-select the same cell.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the display-mode change to the “if” option, re-select the same cell, and confirm rack information is displayed; if a symbol is present, select it to view its meaning.
access_or_tools_needed: OptiSweep HMI screen with cell grid
Display-mode control that includes the “if” option
Selectable symbol on the cell (if present)

visual_references.description: Frame showing the spoken behavior: change display mode to “if”, then select the same cell to show rack information; also mentions selecting the symbol to understand what it means.

steps.title: Change the display mode to the “if” option
steps.purpose: Set the HMI display mode so that re-selecting the same cell will show rack information for that cell.
steps.instruction: On the OptiSweep HMI cell grid screen, change the display mode to the option spoken as “if”.
steps.expected_result: The display mode is set to the “if” option on the HMI.
steps.healthy_condition: The display-mode control reflects the “if” selection (i.e., the HMI is in the “if” display mode).
steps.failure_condition: The display mode does not change to the “if” option (or the control does not reflect the “if” selection).

actions.label: Set display mode to “if”
actions.exact_action: Change the display mode as described in the training segment (spoken as “change it to if”).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: 'If you change it to if... and you select the same cell, it'll show you the rack information.' Nearby text includes the rack-information statement and symbol-meaning discussion.

steps.title: Select the same cell again
steps.purpose: Trigger the HMI’s context-sensitive behavior so rack information appears for the selected cell.
steps.instruction: After setting display mode to “if”, select the same cell again on the OptiSweep HMI cell grid.
steps.expected_result: The same cell is selected again after the display mode change.
steps.healthy_condition: The cell remains/returns to the selected state on the HMI cell grid after re-selection.
steps.failure_condition: Re-selecting the cell does not result in the cell being selected again (no selected state change).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: 'If you change it to if... and you select the same cell, it'll show you the rack information.'

steps.title: Verify rack information is displayed for that cell
steps.purpose: Confirm the HMI has updated to show rack information for the selected cell under the “if” display mode behavior.
steps.instruction: Check the HMI area where rack information is shown for the selected cell after re-selecting it.
steps.expected_result: Rack information is displayed for the selected cell.
steps.healthy_condition: Rack information fields/area update to reflect the selected cell’s rack details.
steps.failure_condition: Rack information does not appear for that cell after changing display mode to “if” and re-selecting the same cell.

actions.label: Confirm rack information appears
actions.exact_action: Verify that rack information is displayed for that cell.

stop_or_escalate_if: If rack information does not appear after re-selecting the same cell, stop and escalate for support (source does not provide additional troubleshooting steps).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: 'If you change it to if... and you select the same cell, it'll show you the rack information.'

steps.title: If applicable, select the symbol to understand what it means
steps.purpose: Interpret the symbol shown for the cell by using the HMI’s symbol-meaning interaction.
steps.instruction: If a selectable symbol is shown for the cell, select the symbol to view what the symbol means.
steps.expected_result: Selecting the symbol reveals the symbol’s meaning.
steps.healthy_condition: A symbol-meaning display/response appears after selecting the symbol.
steps.failure_condition: Selecting the symbol does not reveal any meaning/response.

actions.label: Select the cell symbol
actions.exact_action: If applicable, select the symbol shown for the cell to understand what the symbol means.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: 'select the symbol means something.' Nearby text includes the symbol-meaning discussion.

success_criteria: After changing display mode to “if” and re-selecting the same cell, rack information is displayed for that cell.
If a symbol is present, selecting it reveals the symbol’s meaning.
healthy_conditions: HMI display mode shows the “if” option.
The selected cell is highlighted/selected after re-selection.
Rack information area updates to show rack information for the selected cell.
Selecting the symbol produces a meaning/interpretation display.
failure_conditions: Rack information does not appear after changing display mode to “if” and re-selecting the same cell.
Selecting the symbol does not reveal its meaning (when a symbol is present).
escalation_guidance: If rack information does not appear after re-selecting the same cell, stop and escalate for support. The source provides no additional troubleshooting steps beyond this behavior.
